profile.connection: user-confirmed direct Genesis Mini battery connector

sensor.method: Arduino calibrated ADC API, median of nine, filtered

guard: Readings below 3.0 V or above 4.35 V have no percentage. Unverified voltage is not a measured state of charge or remaining capacity.
scope: Dev only. No USB flash, battery charging/power-control changes, eFuse changes or staging/production deployment.
initial_attempt: 0.4.0 was not accepted as live-healthy evidence; 0.3.9 recovered. A monitored 0.4.1 boot proved sampling, rendering calls and authenticated network polling. No unobserved failure cause is claimed.
